name: GitHub Deployments
description: GitHub action for working painlessly with deployment statuses.

env.description: The name of the deployment environment in GitHub to create statuses in.

repository.description: Set status for a different repository, using the format `$owner/$repository` (optional, defaults to the current repository)

ref.description: The git ref to use for the deploy, defaults to `github.ref`

task.description: The task to assign to the deployment, defaults to 'deploy'

debug.description: Print arguments used by this action and other debug information.

deployment_id.description: The deployment ID to update (if specified during `start`, the deployment will be updated instead of creating a new one)

override.description: Whether to manually mark existing deployments of this environment as inactive (for `start` and `finish` only)

auto_inactive.description: Whether to mark existing deployments as inactive if a deployment succeeds (for `finish` only)

payload.description: JSON-formatted dictionary with extra information about the deployment (for `start` only)
